items.source: Construct a new instance with the provided ObjectMapper customized with the JacksonModules found by MapperBuilder.findModules(ClassLoader) and MimeTypes.
items.translation: 使用由 `MapperBuilder.findModules(ClassLoader)` 查找到的 `JacksonModule` 和 `MimeType` 自定义提供的 `ObjectMapper` 构建新实例。

items.source: Select an ObjectMapper to use, either the main ObjectMapper or another if the handling for the given Class has been customized through registerMappersForType(Class, Consumer).
items.translation: 选择一个要使用的 ObjectMapper，即主 ObjectMapper 或另一个，如果针对给定 Class 的处理已通过 registerMappersForType(Class, Consumer) 进行了自定义。

items.source: Note: Use of this method effectively turns off use of the default ObjectMapper and supported MimeTypes for the given class. Therefore it is important for the mappings configured here to include every MediaType that must be supported for the given class.
items.translation: 注意： 使用此方法实际上会禁用默认 ObjectMapper 和针对给定类支持的 MimeTypes。因此，在此处配置的映射必须 include 给定类所需支持的所有 MediaType。

items.source: Construct a new instance with the provided builder customized with the JacksonModules found by MapperBuilder.findModules(ClassLoader) and MimeTypes.
items.translation: 使用由 `MapperBuilder.findModules(ClassLoader)` 查找到的 `JacksonModule` 和 `MimeType` 定制的提供的 `builder` 构建新实例。

items.source: The key for the hint to specify a "JSON View" for encoding or decoding with the value expected to be a Class.
items.translation: 提示键用于指定编码或解码的"JSON View"，其预期值为 Class。

items.source: Return the supported media type(s) for ProblemDetail. By default, an empty list, unless overridden in subclasses.
items.translation: 返回ProblemDetail的受支持媒体类型。默认情况下为空列表，除非在子类中覆盖。

items.source: The key for the hint to specify a FilterProvider.
items.translation: 提示键用于指定一个FilterProvider。

items.source: Return the configured default mapper.
items.translation: 返回configured默认映射器。

items.source: Return ObjectMapper registrations for the given class, if any.
items.translation: 返回给定类的 ObjectMapper 注册信息（如果有）。

items.source: Subclasses should expose this as "decodable" or "encodable" mime types.
items.translation: 子类应将其暴露为“可解码”或“可编码”的 MIME 类型。

items.source: clazz - the type of Object to register ObjectMapper instances for
items.translation: clazz - 要注册 ObjectMapper 实例的对象类型

items.source: registrar - a consumer to populate or otherwise update the MediaType-to-ObjectMapper associations for the given Class
items.translation: registrar - 一个消费者，用于填充或以其他方式更新给定类的 MediaType 到 ObjectMapper 的关联。

items.source: clazz - the class to look up for registrations for
items.translation: clazz - 要查找注册的类

items.source:
a map with registered MediaType-to-ObjectMapper registrations,
or empty if in case of no registrations for the given class.
items.translation: 一个已注册了 MediaType 到 ObjectMapper 映射的 Map，如果给定类没有注册则返回空。

items.source: Configure the ObjectMapper instances to use for the given Class.
items.translation: 配置用于给定 Class 的 ObjectMapper 实例。

items.source: Return the supported media type(s) for ProblemDetail.
items.translation: 返回 `ProblemDetail` 的受支持媒体类型。

items.source: Base class providing support methods for Jackson 3.x encoding and decoding.
items.translation: 提供 Jackson 3.x 编码和解码支持方法的基类。

items.source: T - the type of ObjectMapper
items.translation: T - ObjectMapper 的类型
